q: How should a Durban chemical plant calculate its Scope 1 and 2 emissions?
title: Durban chemical plant: Scope 1 and 2
short: Scope 1 covers fuel in boilers and heaters, process emissions from reactions and any flaring or venting. Scope 2 is Eskom electricity at the grid factor for the year. South Africa also requires large emitters to report to the national authority, so align the inventory with those returns.
audience: Chemical, resin and specialty plants in Durban South, Jacobs and Prospecton

ul: Coal, gas or oil from invoices.
Process CO2 from reactions, by mass balance.

p: Eskom kWh times the grid factor for the year, with source and year. Steam bought from a neighbour counts here too.
Installations above the national thresholds report to the government each year. Check which activities apply to you under the current regulations.

senseible: Senseible reads fuel, electricity and freight invoices into a dated, fingerprinted record per site, so each figure you send a buyer traces back to the documents behind it.
